rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: Google向けにカスタムTPUを開発・供給する長期契約
relations.text_en: Long Term Agreement for Broadcom to develop and supply custom TPUs for Google

source.label: Broadcom 8-K(Item 8.01)
source.quote: Broadcom Inc. (“Broadcom”) and Google LLC (“Google”) have entered into a Long Term Agreement for Broadcom to develop and supply custom Tensor Processing Units (“TPUs”) for Google’s future generations of TPUs
source.note: 契約の相手方はGoogle LLCです。
source.note_en: The agreement counterparty is Google LLC.

relations.text: 次世代のApple Foundation Modelsの基盤にGoogleのGeminiを使う複数年の協業
relations.text_en: Multi-year collaboration: next-generation Apple Foundation Models will be based on Google’s Gemini

source.label: Google ブログ: Joint statement from Google and Apple
source.label_en: Google blog: Joint statement from Google and Apple
source.quote: Apple and Google have entered into a multi-year collaboration under which the next generation of Apple Foundation Models will be based on Google's Gemini models and cloud technology.

relations.text: AppleはApple製品でのGoogle検索の提供に対するライセンス収入を得ている
relations.text_en: Apple earns revenue from licensing arrangements with Google to offer Google search on Apple platforms

source.label: Apple 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the Company earns revenue from licensing arrangements with Google LLC (“Google”) and other companies to offer their search services on the Company’s platforms and applications
source.note: 米司法省の訴訟の判決や控訴の影響を受けると記載しています。
source.note_en: Apple describes these arrangements as subject to the DOJ v. Google remedies order and appeal.

relations.text: FluidstackのTeraWulfでのリース債務の保証を約32億ドルに拡大し、新株予約権を保有
relations.text_en: Increased its backstop of Fluidstack lease obligations at TeraWulf to about $3.2B and holds warrants

source.label: TeraWulf の発表(8-K Ex. 99.1)
source.quote: Google Increases Backstop to $3.2 Billion and Stake in TeraWulf to 14%
source.note: 株式の保有は新株予約権を通じたものです。
source.note_en: The equity stake is via warrants.

companies.name: サイファー・デジタル

relations.text: FluidstackのCipherでのリース債務14億ドルを保証し、新株予約権を取得
relations.text_en: Backstops $1.4B of Fluidstack lease obligations at Cipher and receives warrants

source.label: Cipher Mining の発表(8-K Ex. 99.1)
source.quote: Google will backstop $1.4 billion of Fluidstack’s lease obligations to support project-related debt financing and will receive warrants to acquire approximately 24 million shares of Cipher common stock, equating to an approximately 5.4% pro forma equity ow
source.note: 株式の保有は新株予約権を通じたものです。

relations.text: Kyndrylは、共同ソリューション開発の主要な提携先にGoogle Cloudを置く
relations.text_en: Google Cloud is one of Kyndryl's key alliance partners.

source.label: Kyndryl 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: We have several key partnerships, including with Amazon Web Services, Broadcom, Cisco, Dell, Dynatrace, Google Cloud

relations.text: ServiceNowは、AI強化のため関係を広げた技術提供企業の1社として、Googleと組む
relations.text_en: ServiceNow expanded its relationship with Google to strengthen its AI capabilities.

source.label: ServiceNow 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We have expanded relationships with technology providers to strengthen our AI capabilities and improve cloud interoperability, including relationships with AWS, Google, Microsoft, and NVIDIA

relations.text: Waymoの自動運転車をUberのプラットフォームで提供
relations.text_en: Waymo makes a fleet of autonomous vehicles available through the Uber platform

source.label: Uber 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Waymo has introduced a commercialized ridehailing fleet of autonomous vehicles on its own platform in addition to a fleet of autonomous vehicles that it makes available through our platform
source.note_en: The relationship is with Waymo, an Alphabet subsidiary.

relations.text: ナッシュビルの車両運用をWaymoと提携して実施
relations.text_en: Fleet operations in Nashville run in partnership with Waymo

source.label: Lyft 決算発表(8-K、2026年第2四半期)
source.quote: In Nashville, in partnership with Waymo, our fleet operations officially began in June
source.note_en: The relationship is with Waymo, an Alphabet subsidiary.

relations.text: Snapは計算処理の大半をGoogle CloudとAWSで動かしている
relations.text_en: Snap runs the vast majority of its computing on Google Cloud and AWS

source.label: Snap 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We currently run the vast majority of our computing on Google Cloud and AWS

relations.text: Alphabet(GoogleとYouTube)は、Snapが競合する企業の1社だ
relations.text_en: Alphabet (including Google and YouTube) competes with Snap.

source.label: Snap 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: such as Alphabet (including Google and YouTube), Apple, ByteDance (TikTok and affiliated joint ventures), Meta (including Facebook, Instagram, Threads, and WhatsApp), Pinterest

relations.text: Snowflakeの基盤はAWS・Azure・Google Cloudで稼働する
relations.text_en: Snowflake's platform operates on public cloud infrastructure from AWS, Azure and Google Cloud

source.label: Snowflake 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: our platform currently operates on public cloud infrastructure provided by Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure (Azure), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
source.note: SnowflakeはGoogle Cloudを競合としても挙げています。
source.note_en: Snowflake also lists Google Cloud among its competitors.

relations.text: Alphabetは、AI計算機能を自社設計に組み込む企業の1社として、NVIDIAと競合する
relations.text_en: Alphabet competes with NVIDIA by designing hardware and software with AI computing functionality.

source.label: NVIDIA 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: such as Alibaba Group, Alphabet Inc., Amazon, Inc., or Amazon, Baidu, Inc., Huawei, and Microsoft Corporation, or Microsoft

relations.text: Alphabetは、Oracleのクラウドと直接競合する大手の一社である
relations.text_en: Alphabet is one of the largest companies whose offerings compete directly with Oracle's cloud offerings.

source.label: Oracle 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: including Adobe Systems Incorporated, Alphabet Inc., Amazon.com, Inc., Cisco Systems, Inc., Intel Corporation, International Business Machines Corporation, Microsoft Corporation, Salesforce, Inc. and SAP SE

relations.text: Alphabet(Google)は、IBMのソフトウェア事業における主要な競合だ
relations.text_en: Alphabet (Google) is a principal competitor of IBM in its software segment.

source.label: IBM 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The principal competitors in this segment include: Alphabet (Google), Amazon, BMC, Broadcom, Microsoft, Oracle, Salesforce, SAP and Splunk

relations.text: Google(Gemini・Lens・YouTubeを含む)は、Pinterestと競合する立場にある
relations.text_en: Google (including Gemini, Lens and YouTube) competes with Pinterest.

source.label: Pinterest 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Competitors such as Amazon, Meta (including Facebook, Instagram, Threads and MetaAI), Google (including Gemini, Lens and YouTube)

relations.text: Alphabetは、音声配信サービスを機器に事前搭載してSpotifyと競う1社だ
relations.text_en: Alphabet is a Spotify competitor that preloads its own audio services on devices.

source.label: Spotify 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Some of our competitors, including Apple, Alphabet, and Amazon, have developed, and are continuing to develop, devices for which their audio streaming services are preloaded

relations.text: Googleは、Yelpにとって検索・ディレクトリ分野で最大の競合である
relations.text_en: Google is Yelp's primary competitor among online search engines and directories.

source.label: Yelp 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: such as our primary competitor, Google

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
